description: This file defines the PreferLocalPlacementDirector class, which is a placement strategy for activating grains in Orleans. It extends RandomPlacementDirector and prioritizes placing new activations on the local silo if possible, using a cached task for efficiency.

classes.name: PreferLocalPlacementDirector
classes.description: A placement director that prefers to activate grains on the local silo, extending RandomPlacementDirector and implementing IPlacementDirector.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Overrides the base method to select a silo for activation, preferring the local silo if it is active and compatible.
